lastCompletedStory.title: Unit test: injected failing sync subprocess keeps commitTreeToMain non-throwing and sha-stable

openQuestions: branchWasMain is vestigial since CAM-133 now that syncWorktreeIfOnMain self-detects the branch. Consider a cleanup story to remove it from specifyIssueOnMain/abandonIssueOnMain return shapes (not required by US-001 or US-002).
nextStoryContext: All three stories in this PRD now pass. US-003 added one combined test (AC1+AC2) to test/on-main-multi.test.ts: it injects a spawnFn that reports branch=main (so the sync fires) and fails git restore, then asserts non-throw + sha-stable + warning written to process.stdout.write. The monkey-patch pattern (save/restore in finally) is clean and restores stdout after the assertion. Total test count: 24 in test/on-main-multi.test.ts, 2116 across the suite. All quality gates green (check:all).

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-003 only modifies a unit test file (test/on-main-multi.test.ts). No new external library is exercised in production code.
